lastCompletedStory.title: Regression test: findings reach fix stories from review-report.json and missing-file is graceful

nextStoryContext: US-006 added one new describe block 'makeReviewDispatch: US-006 regression - findings come from file, not pane' with a single AC3 test to test/supervisor/review.test.ts (+119 lines, 49 total tests in that file, 1279 total). The AC3 test sets capturePane to return rendered markdown text (bullets/brackets stripped, pane-side flavor text) while readReviewReport returns structured findings with distinctive text; asserts verbatim file content in fix-story notes; negatively asserts pane-only text is absent from notes. AC1 and AC2 were already covered by existing tests added in prior stories. US-007 is operator-required (live dogfood); PRD is effectively complete for autonomous implementation.
